result.description:
- Lead world-class brain MRI research improving child health outcomes
- Develop AI-driven neuroimaging tools for clinical translation
- Collaborate with leading researchers and clinicians globally
 

Advance neonatal brain imaging research using AI and MRI to improve outcomes for babies and children!


The opportunity:


As part of the Developmental Imaging Group, you'll lead the analysis of large neuroimaging datasets from studies involving preterm infants, fetal growth restriction and congenital heart disease.

 

You'll also contribute to the development of the Neonatal Automated Neuro-Anatomist (NANA), an innovative automated infant brain analysis platform designed to support future clinical practice. Working with dedicated high-performance computing resources, you'll collaborate with clinicians, engineers and researchers to develop advanced image analysis methods and publish impactful research.


What you’ll do

 

Lead the analysis and quality assurance of large-scale paediatric MRI datasets
Develop advanced neuroimaging analysis methods and image processing pipelines
Contribute to AI-enabled brain imaging tools for clinical translation
Publish high-quality research and present findings at national and international conferences
Contribute to competitive grant applications and ethics submissions
Collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams and clinical partners
Support students and contribute to a collaborative research culture
 

What you’ll bring

 

A PhD in Medical Imaging, Neuroscience, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline
Experience in high-throughput neuroimaging analysis
Experience working with clinical MRI datasets, including structural and/or diffusion MRI
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with deep learning or machine learning techniques
Experience using neuroimaging analysis software and automated image processing pipelines

Please view the position description here.

Any questions? Reach out to Deanne Thompson on deanne.thompson@mcri.edu.au.


What you’ll enjoy

 

Work on internationally recognised neuroimaging research projects
Access dedicated high-performance computing resources
Collaborate with leading clinicians, engineers and researchers
Access a range of salary packaging options—covering entertainment, novated leases, and more
Enjoy a variety of flexible work arrangements
Take advantage of generous personal leave and the option to purchase additional leave to suit your lifestyle
Perk up with discounted coffee from Synapse, our vibrant onsite café
Enjoy discounted staff parking, public transport right at your doorstep, and great facilities for cyclists
 

Who we are


Murdoch Children’s Research Institute envisions a transformative future for child health. Our institute is a hub of impactful scientific breakthroughs, particularly in early interventions, enhanced diagnosis, prevention, and potential cures. We thrive on collaborative, multidisciplinary problem-solving to address challenging queries in child health. Committed to inclusivity and respect, we foster a positive working environment that values diverse backgrounds and experiences. As a proud member of the Australian Network on Disability and a dedicated supporter of Science Australia Gender Equity (SAGE), we uphold principles of equal opportunity and diverse representation.


We are committed to the safety of children and young people and takes a zero-tolerance approach to all forms of child abuse, exploitation and harm. Child safety is prioritised in our decision-making at all levels of the Institute.   

 

Apply now!


If you believe this role is a good fit for you, please apply by submitting:

 

Your resume
A cover letter addressing the selection criteria

Ensure these documents are combined into a single PDF file.


We welcome individuals of diverse genders, ages, ethnicities, cultural backgrounds, abilities, religions, and sexual orientations in our workplace. We actively encourage talented individuals from all walks of life to apply for our job openings. Our commitment lies in fostering a workplace that is barrier-free and inclusive, aiming to attract the most skilled candidates.


For any questions related to the recruitment process, feel free to reach out to our Recruitment Team at recruitment@mcri.edu.au. Ensure that you include the position number and job title in the subject line. Please refrain from sharing your application to this email address.

Please note, we reserve the right to close the vacancy prior to the closing date once a sufficient number of applications have been received.

No recruitment agencies please.

Applications close: 11 August 2026

About our Organisation 
VENTORA is the name behind iconic Australian brands including A&L Windows & Doors, Breezway louvres, Corinthian Doors, Stegbar Windows & Doors and Trend Windows & Doors.
As an established manufacturer with over 4,500 employees, our vision is to inspire our customers through leading brands, great service, innovative new products and solutions leveraging the full VENTORA portfolio, while significantly enhancing our ease of doing business built on operational excellence.

About the Opportunity
We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.
Responsibilities include:
•	Drive COPQ Reduction Across Sites: Lead initiatives to identify, address, and reduce COPQ at each manufacturing site, fast-tracking reduction actions.
•	Support Transformation Projects: Provide operational support for the successful execution of Transformation Projects, aiming to modernize manufacturing processes and systems.
•	Red List Site Support: Work directly with Red List sites to build operational foundations and enhance manufacturing readiness for growth, ensuring these sites meet operational standards.
•	Enhance Manufacturing Efficiency: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce downtime, improve throughput, and optimize resource utilization across sites.
•	Leadership Support: Assist site leaders in improving operational performance, driving COPQ reduction, and supporting data-driven decision-making to foster a culture of continuous improvement. 
•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across functions to drive transformation projects and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
•	People Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop operational leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
•	Results-Oriented: A focus on achieving measurable results and driving continuous improvement across all operational areas.
•	Time Management: Effective time management and organizational skills to prioritize tasks, manage workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.
•	Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and implement innovative solutions to improve manufacturing processes and drive operational excellence.
•	Adaptability: Ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
•	Driver’s License: Hold a current unrestricted driver’s license to perform the requirements of the role.
•	Educational Qualification: A diploma or degree in a relevant discipline (business, engineering, manufacturing) or equivalent experience is preferred.

About the Benefits
•	Permanent, full time role with established industry leader
•	Annual salary: $150,000 - $180,000 (depending on experience) + super.
•	Flexible work arrangements, with 2 days per week WFH
•	Generous discounts on our extensive range of products
•	Ability to schedule leave every year over the Christmas period.
•	Additional paid day’s leave on your birthday
•	Flare benefits program - salary packaging, discounts and premium perks
•	Employee Assistance Program access
•	Career progression opportunities as part of a 4,500-employee organisation

result.description:
We are looking for a curious and analytically driven Data Scientist to join our team and transform complex datasets into actionable insights that inform strategic decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of mathematics, statistics, programming, and business intelligence, requiring a candidate who can build and deploy sophisticated analytical frameworks including machine learning and AI solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver with strong communication skills, capable of translating data-driven findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Collect, prepare, and clean large datasets for analysis, identifying and resolving data anomalies, inconsistencies, and quality issues to ensure analytical integrity
Apply advanced analytical techniques drawing on mathematical, statistical, programming, and database skills to extract meaningful insights from structured and unstructured data
Design, build, and deploy machine learning and artificial intelligence frameworks that support automation, prediction, and pattern recognition across business functions
Develop, evaluate, and iteratively refine statistical models and algorithms to uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and generate actionable insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and translate them into clearly defined data science problems and analytical solutions
Present data-driven findings, visualisations, and recommendations to key decision-makers and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner
Contribute strategic input and innovation to the organisation's data science roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage data for competitive advantage
Maintain and document data pipelines, modelling processes, and analytical methodologies to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across the team
Monitor and assess the performance of deployed models, implementing updates and improvements as required to maintain accuracy and relevance
Support data governance and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organisational data management policies
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience in a data science or advanced analytics role, with a portfolio of applied projects
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g. pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
Experience working with large datasets and familiarity with SQL and database querying
Ability to develop and evaluate predictive models, performing validation, tuning, and performance assessment
Proficiency in data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent libraries (e.g. Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex findings into clear, business-relevant insights
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative or data-related field
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, particularly for model deployment and data storage
Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, monitoring, and deployment pipelines
Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or other specialist machine learning domains
Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery frameworks
Relevant industry certifications in data science, machine learning, or cloud computing (e.g. AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer)
Prior experience in a relevant industry sector such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
Why Join Us?
Be part of a forward-thinking team that places data and innovation at the core of strategic decision-making, giving you meaningful impact from day one
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for further study, certifications, and attendance at industry conferences
Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance
Competitive remuneration package with superannuation and opportunities for performance-based progression
Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diverse perspectives and encourages knowledge sharing
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
